title: Airwire headset

fields.name: Airwire headset
fields.description: A simple head-mounted comms computer that slightly enhances a mechanitor's control bandwidth. This allows them to control more mechs.

intro: The airwire headset is a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC that increases the bandwidth of mechanitors.

title: Array headset

fields.name: Array headset
fields.description: A head-mounted computer and signaling array that enhances a mechanitor's control bandwidth. This allows them to control more mechs.

intro: The array headset is a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC that increases the bandwidth of mechanitors.

title: Authority cap

fields.name: Authority cap
fields.description: A hat with a stiff brim and peaked top. It's not particularly protective, but it creates a sense of authority and makes the wearer more effective in suppressing slaves.

intro: Authority caps are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC. They enhance the ability of a warden to suppress slaves.

title: Beret

fields.name: Beret
fields.description: A soft, round, flat-crowned hat.

intro: The beret is a clothing item added in the Royalty DLC. It provides a +10% increase to Social Impact, and meets the headwear requirements of nobles between Acolyte and Praetor rank.

title: Blindfold

fields.name: Blindfold
fields.description: A long strip of cloth that is wrapped over the eyes to block vision.

intro: Blindfolds are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC that reduces Sight and pleases ideoligions that venerate blindness.

title: Bowler hat

fields.name: Bowler hat
fields.description: A good-looking hat which projects a slightly urban, money-loving style. Improves social impact.

intro: The bowler hat is a clothing item that covers the head. It provides a +15% increase to Social Impact, minimal armor for the head and ears, and modest insulation.

title: Broadwrap

fields.name: Broadwrap
fields.description: Wrapped fabric sheets that loosely cover the wearer's head and shoulders.
fields.coverage: Neck, Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw, Left Shoulder, Right Shoulder

intro: Broadwraps are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC. It provides modest insulation and good protection for clothing based headwear, and covers the entire head, neck and shoulders of the wearer.

title: Burka

fields.name: Burka
fields.description: A large garment that conceals the wearer's entire head and body.
fields.coverage: Torso, Head, Left eye, Right eye, Left ear, Right ear, Nose, Jaw, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: Burkas are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC. They cover the entire body but inflict a move speed penalty.

title: Button-down shirt

fields.name: Button-down shirt
fields.description: A nice-looking collared shirt with buttons.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm

intro: The button-down shirt is one of two shirts available in core RimWorld.

title: Cape

fields.name: Cape
fields.description: A long cape of elegant design. It hangs over one side of the torso.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: The cape is a clothing item originally added in the Royalty DLC, but it will also be present if the Biotech DLC is enabled. Nobles of Acolyte rank and above require either one of these, or either a prestige or eltex robe, to consider themselves properly dressed and avoid a negative moodlet. Moral guides can also similarly require them.

title: Cataphract armor

fields.name: Cataphract armor
fields.description: A suit of heavy powered armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered plasteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome. Armor like this is used by imperial cataphracts to break heavily fortified positions in frontal assaults when no other option is available.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: Cataphract armor is a type of power armor introduced by the Royalty DLC that can effectively block gunshots, cuts, blunt trauma, or burns at the expense of a penalty to move speed. It forms a full set of armor along with the Cataphract helmet.

title: Cataphract helmet

fields.name: Cataphract helmet
fields.description: A heavily-armored high-tech helmet, with a solid plasteel-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots. Armor like this is used by imperial cataphracts to break heavily fortified positions in frontal assaults when no other option is available.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: A Cataphract helmet is a type of advanced armor introduced by the Royalty DLC that can effectively block gunshots, cuts, blunt trauma, or burns. It forms a full set along with the Cataphract armor.

title: Ceremonial hood

fields.name: Ceremonial hood
fields.description: A ceremonial mask typically worn by those that worship the void and its ruler.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: The ceremonial hood is an item of clothing added by the Anomaly DLC.

title: Coronet

fields.name: Coronet
fields.description: A tiny crown-like piece of headwear made of metal.

intro: The Coronet is a clothing item added in the Royalty DLC. It provides a +20% increase to Social Impact, and meets the headwear requirements of nobles of Baron and Count rank.

title: Corset

fields.name: Corset
fields.description: An embroidered corset with strong wire support to maintain a ladylike shape. Appropriate for middle-upper-ranked noblewomen.

intro: The Corset is a clothing item added in the Royalty DLC.

title: Cowboy hat

fields.name: Cowboy hat
fields.description: Stylish yet rugged, this hat keeps the sun and rain off - and it gives anyone who wears it a bit of extra charm. It is the most important part of traditional western attire.

intro: The cowboy hat is a clothing item that covers the head. It provides a +10% increase to Social Impact, minimal armor for the head and ears, and good insulation against heat.

title: Crown

fields.name: Crown
fields.description: A crown of metal with an elaborate design.

intro: The Crown is a clothing item added in the Royalty DLC. It provides a +20% increase to Social Impact, and meets the headwear requirements of nobles of Consul rank.

title: Duster

fields.name: Duster
fields.description: A long duster coat for blocking the sun and grit of the desert.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: Dusters are an item of apparel that provides good heat insulation and protection.

title: Eltex helmet

fields.name: Eltex helmet
fields.description: A lightweight helmet designed for psychic focusing. While it provides little physical protection, its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat.

intro: The eltex helmet is, despite the name, an item of clothing added by the Royalty DLC that improves psychic sensitivity and makes psycasters more effective.

title: Eltex robe

fields.name: Eltex robe
fields.description: A long robe embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: The eltex robe is an item of clothing added by the Royalty DLC that improves psychic sensitivity and makes psycasters more effective.

title: Eltex shirt

fields.name: Eltex shirt
fields.description: A shirt embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.

intro: The eltex shirt is an item of clothing added by the Royalty DLC that improves psychic sensitivity and makes psycasters more effective.

title: Eltex skullcap

fields.name: Eltex skullcap
fields.description: A tight skullcap designed for psychic focusing. It provides no physical protection, but its special materials enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity and dissipate neural heat.

intro: The eltex skullcap is an item of clothing added by the Royalty DLC that improves psychic sensitivity and makes psycasters more effective.

title: Eltex vest

fields.name: Eltex vest
fields.description: A thin vest embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Right Shoulder

intro: The eltex vest is an item of clothing added by the Royalty DLC that improves psychic sensitivity and makes psycasters more effective.

title: Face mask

fields.name: Face mask
fields.description: A piece of fabric which covers the wearer's mouth and nose with several layers of textile. It is remarkably effective in reducing the effects of environmental toxins.

intro: The face mask is a piece of apparel that covers the face and provides Toxic Environment Resistance.

title: Flak helmet

fields.name: Flak helmet
fields.description: A lightweight combat helmet with a complex design, reinforced with plasteel. Not effective against blunt attacks.

intro: The flak helmet is an advanced helmet for protection. A step up from the simple helmet, this is a mid-tier helmet for most colonist uses. It is the lightest of all the helmets, only weighing 1.2 kg.

title: Flak jacket

fields.name: Flak jacket
fields.description: A tough fabric jacket with armor plates sewn in. While it's not as good as solid armor, it offers effective protection against all manner of attacks while remaining quite comfortable.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm

intro: The flak jacket is a piece of armor that provides protection to the torso and arms at the cost of a penalty to move speed.

title: Flak pants

fields.name: Flak pants
fields.description: A pair of pants with armor plates sewn in. While it's not as good as solid armor, it offers effective protection against all manner of attacks while remaining quite comfortable.

intro: Flak pants is a piece of armor that provides protection to the legs at the cost a penalty to move speed.

title: Flak vest

fields.name: Flak vest
fields.description: A vest with armor plates inserted on the chest and back. While quite effective at deflecting gunshots and stabbing attacks against the chest, it does nothing to protect the limbs.

intro: The flak vest is a type of armor that protects well against sharp/piercing attacks (e.g. bullets, stabs, cuts, bites), and offer minor protection against blunt attacks, explosions and the ever-present threat of clubs, maces, and wild animals.

title: Flophat

fields.name: Flophat
fields.description: A large, thick cap, similar to a tuque. It has extra fabric along the back.

intro: Flophats are a form of head clothing added by the Ideology DLC that provide exceptional cold insulation but lack the protection of helmets or the Social Impact bonuses of other hats.

title: Formal shirt

fields.name: Formal shirt
fields.description: A decorated formal shirt with buttons.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm

intro: The formal shirt is a clothing item added in the Royalty DLC. Nobles of Acolyte rank and above require either one of these, or a eltex shirt, to consider themselves properly dressed and avoid a negative moodlet.

title: Formal vest

fields.name: Formal vest
fields.description: A vest embroidered with complex decorative designs.

intro: The formal vest is a clothing item added in the Royalty DLC, and is one the items of apparel that appeases nobles. The Female equivalent is the corset.

title: Gas mask

fields.name: Gas mask
fields.description: A flexible mask worn over the face with an embedded air filter. It dramatically reduces exposure to pollution through the lungs, but does not protect the skin on the rest of the body.; It prevents tox gas irritants from entering through the eyes and mouth.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: The gas mask is a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Gunlink

fields.name: Gunlink
fields.description: A targeting computer that helps the user aim. It detects and analyzes targets using infrared, visible, and millimeter-wave electromagnetic sensors. An onboard targeting computer displays firing solutions on a retinal projection. It offers no protection at all.

intro: The gunlink is a piece of headwear added by the Royalty DLC that increases the wearer's accuracy with ranged weapons but provides no protection or insulation.

title: Headwrap

fields.name: Headwrap
fields.description: A wrapped piece of fabric which covers the wearer's hair.

intro: Headwraps are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC. Traditional head coverings.

title: Heavy bandolier

fields.name: Heavy bandolier
fields.description: A heavy shoulder-belt for keeping spare munitions close at hand. It allows quick access to bullets, grenades, arrows, or whatever the user needs, reducing their weapon's ranged cooldown. Due to its bulk, it can't be worn under other clothing. It doesn't cover the body, so it can be worn happily by nudists and yttakin.

intro: The heavy bandolier is a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Hood

fields.name: Hood
fields.description: A draped hood which covers the head and ears.

intro: The hood is a clothing item initially added in the Royalty DLC but now part of RimWorld core. They provide a +20% increase to Social Impact.

title: Integrator headset

fields.name: Integrator headset
fields.description: An advanced head-mounted computer and signaling array that dramatically enhances a mechanitor's control bandwidth. This allows the wearer to control many more mechanoids at once.

intro: The integrator headset is a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC that increases the bandwidth of mechanitors.

title: Jacket

fields.name: Jacket
fields.description: A tough jacket to stop scrapes and bruises, and keep one warm in chilly weather.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm

intro: Jackets are a middle ground between a duster and a parka, best suited to moderately cold biomes not extreme enough to require parkas.

title: Jump pack

fields.name: Jump pack
fields.description:
A single-person burst rocket for short-ranged flight. With its integrated harness and guidance assistant, the jump pack allows anyone to leap long distances at high speed, even over obstacles. It must be recharged after several uses.
Some spacer tech militaries have melee combat specialists who use jump packs to bypass obstacles and rapidly close with the enemy.

intro: The jump pack is a utility item added by Royalty DLC that allows its user to make rapid rocket powered jumps to a tile within range and in line of sight.

title: Kid helmet

fields.name: Kid helmet
fields.description: A simple helmet sized for children. It gives moderate protection against sharp attacks. Not effective against blunt weapons. That said, if this is being used in combat something has already gone very wrong.

intro: The kid helmet is a headgear apparel added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Kid pants

fields.name: Kid pants
fields.description: A small set of pants sized to fit children.

intro: Kid pants are a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Kid parka

fields.name: Kid parka
fields.description: A heavy jacket for keeping a child warm in cold temperatures.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm

intro: The kid parka is a child-sized item of apparel added by the Biotech DLC that provides excellent cold insulation.

title: Kid romper

fields.name: Kid romper
fields.description: A combined t-shirt and pants sized for kids, with a snuggly built-in undergarment. Little ones love it!
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: The kid romper is a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Kid shirt

fields.name: Kid shirt
fields.description: A small, simple t-shirt sized to fit children.

intro: The kid shirt is a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Kid tribalwear

fields.name: Kid tribalwear
fields.description: A one-piece garment sized for kids, crafted using neolithic tools. It provides effective insulation against the elements.

intro: Kid tribalwear is a neolithic piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Kid vacsuit

fields.name: Kid vacsuit
fields.description: A protective suit designed for children. It keeps the user safe in the vacuum of space.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: The kid vacsuit is an item of apparel added by the Odyssey DLC and only present with the Biotech DLC enabled. It forms a set with the vacsuit helmet.

title: Lab coat

fields.name: Lab coat
fields.description: A knee-length overcoat worn over other clothing. It has a number of large pockets for holding scientific equipment, helping the wearer conduct research more efficiently.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm

intro: Lab coats are an apparel item added by the Anomaly DLC that improves the capabilities of researchers.

title: Ladies hat

fields.name: Ladies hat
fields.description: A dainty ladies' hat with complex embroidery.

intro: The ladies hat is a clothing item added in the Royalty DLC. It provides a +20% increase to Social Impact, and meets the headwear requirements of female nobles between Acolyte and Praetor rank.

title: Locust armor

fields.name: Locust armor
fields.description: A variant of recon armor with an integrated burst rocket for short-ranged flight. Locust armor is slightly less protective than standard recon armor. Each jump consumes a burst of fuel, so the armor must be reloaded after several uses.; Unlike most ultratech military units, locusts train primarily with melee weapons. They usually avoid static shootouts, preferring to jump straight into enemy fortifications and fight hand-to-hand. They do poorly in static defense or confined quarters, but excel in mixed cover or shipcracking operations.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: Locust armor is a set of armor added by Royalty DLC that allows its user to make rapid rocket powered jumps to a tile within range and in line of sight while also protecting from attacks. It is a variant of recon armor and forms a full set with the recon helmet

title: Marine armor

fields.name: Marine armor
fields.description: A suit of powered armor. Layered plasteel-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.; Armor like this is often used by rapid-incursion space marines.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: Marine armor is a set of power armor that forms a full set along with the Marine helmet and can effectively block gunshots, cuts, blunt trauma, or burns at the cost of a penalty to move speed

title: Marine helmet

fields.name: Marine helmet
fields.description: A marine armor helmet, with a built-in status computer and layered plasteel-weave plates. Armor like this is often used by rapid-incursion space marines.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: A marine helmet is a full-head power armor helmet that forms a full set along with the marine armor.

title: Mechcommander helmet

fields.name: Mechcommander helmet
fields.description: A plasteel-weave combat helmet designed for battle mechanitors. It is embedded with computers and signal enhancers that moderately increase the wearer's maximum control bandwidth. This allows the mechanitor to control more mechs.
fields.coverage: Head, Left eye, Right eye, Left ear, Right ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: The mechcommander helmet is a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Mechlord helmet

fields.name: Mechlord helmet
fields.description: A heavy plasteel-weave helmet packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord helmet dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor.
fields.coverage: Head, Left eye, Right eye, Left ear, Right ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: The mechlord helmet is a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Mechlord suit

fields.name: Mechlord suit
fields.description: A power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord suit dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: The mechlord suit is a piece of armor added by the Biotech DLC. It provides modest armor and a significant increase in bandwidth.

title: Pants

fields.name: Pants
fields.description: A simple set of pants.

intro: Pants are the most common legwear on the rimworlds, offering a bit of protection from damage, a small amount of insulation, and preventing the "naked" mood debuff (males only need to cover their legs to avoid feeling naked, while females also need to cover their torso).

title: Parka

fields.name: Parka
fields.description: A thick parka for staying warm even in the coldest of temperatures.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm

intro: Parkas are items of apparel that provide exceptional cold insulation.

title: Plate armor

fields.name: Plate armor
fields.description: Overlapping solid plates of armor covering the entire body from neck to feet.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: Plate armor is a type of apparel (armor) that functions as low-tech full body armor. It can be crafted out of various materials and inflicts a move speed penalty when worn.

title: Prestige cataphract armor

fields.name: Prestige cataphract armor
fields.description: A suit of heavy powered armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered plasteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.; Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: Prestige cataphract armor is a set of power armor introduced by the Royalty DLC that forms a full set along with the Prestige cataphract helmet. It combines the defensive ability and move speed penalty of Cataphract armor with the psychic boosts of Eltex apparel.

title: Prestige cataphract helmet

fields.name: Prestige cataphract helmet
fields.description: A heavily-armored high-tech helmet, with a solid plasteel-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots.; Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: A prestige cataphract helmet is a full-head power armor helmet introduced by the Royalty DLC that forms a full set along with the prestige cataphract armor. It combines the defensive ability of the cataphract helmet with additional the psychic boosts and noble-pleasing of eltex apparel.

title: Prestige marine armor

fields.name: Prestige marine armor
fields.description: A suit of powered armor. Layered plasteel-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.; Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: Prestige marine armor is a set of power armor introduced by the Royalty DLC that forms a full set along with the Prestige marine helmet. It combines the defensive ability and move speed penalty of Marine armor with the psychic boosts of Eltex apparel.

title: Prestige marine helmet

fields.name: Prestige marine helmet
fields.description: A marine armor helmet, with a built-in status computer and layered plasteel-weave plates.; Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: A prestige marine helmet is a full-head power armor helmet introduced by the Royalty DLC that forms a full set along with the Prestige marine armor. It combines the defensive ability of the Marine helmet with additional the psychic boosts and noble-pleasing of Eltex apparel.

title: Prestige recon armor

fields.name: Prestige recon armor
fields.description: A suit of light partially-powered armor, designed to permit quick movement. Plasteel-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.; Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: Prestige recon armor is a set of power armor introduced by the Royalty DLC that forms a full set along with the Prestige recon helmet. It combines the defensive ability of Recon armor with additional the psychic boosts of Eltex apparel.

title: Prestige recon helmet

fields.name: Prestige recon helmet
fields.description: A high-tech armored helmet with a built-in status computer and a protective plasteel-weave plate.; Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: A prestige recon helmet is a full-head power armor helmet introduced by the Royalty DLC that forms a full set along with the prestige recon armor. It combines the defensive ability of the recon helmet with additional the psychic boosts and noble-pleasing of eltex apparel.

title: Prestige robe

fields.name: Prestige robe
fields.description: A long, flowing robe embroidered with complex decorative designs.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: The prestige robe is a clothing item added by the Royalty DLC. Nobles of Archon rank and above require these, a cape, an eltex robe, or prestige power armor to consider themselves properly dressed and avoid a negative moodlet.

title: Psychic foil helmet

fields.name: Psychic foil helmet
fields.description: A thin helmet containing finely-tuned sheets of psychically-absorptive foil. Reduces the impact of psychic waves.

intro: The psychic foil helmet is a piece of headgear that decreases the psychic sensitivity of the wearer, and is primarily useful for protecting an individual pawn against psychic phenomena.

title: Recon armor

fields.name: Recon armor
fields.description: A suit of light partially-powered armor, designed to permit quick movement. Lightweight plasteel-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily. Armor like this is often used by imperial scout troops and glitterworld police forces.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: Recon armor is a set of power armor that forms a full set along with the Recon helmet.

title: Recon helmet

fields.name: Recon helmet
fields.description: A high-tech armored helmet with a built-in status computer and a protective plasteel-weave plate. Armor like this is often used by imperial scout troops or glitterworld police forces.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: A Recon helmet is a full-head power armor helmet that forms a full set along with the Recon armor.

title: Ritual mask

fields.name: Ritual mask
fields.description: A haunting mask worn by those that worship the void.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: The ritual mask is an item of clothing added by the Anomaly DLC.

title: Robe

fields.name: Robe
fields.description: A long, flowing robe without a hood.
fields.coverage: Torso, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: The robe is a form of clothing who offers almost full body coverage, modest cold insulation, and a solemn look.

title: Sash

fields.name: Sash
fields.description: A long strip of material worn over one shoulder. It offers minimal protection from heat, cold, and attacks. Due to its minimalist nature, nudists won't complain about wearing it.

intro: The sash is a piece of apparel added by the Biotech DLC.

title: Shadecone

fields.name: Shadecone
fields.description: A conical woven hat. Good for keeping cool during long hours in the sun.

intro: Shadecone are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC. It provides significant heat insulation for a headwear option.

title: Simple helmet

fields.name: Simple helmet
fields.description: A simple helmet which gives moderate protection against sharp attacks. Not effective against blunt attacks.

intro: The simple helmet is the first available headgear that can be crafted from metal.

title: Slave body strap

fields.name: Slave body strap
fields.description: An uncomfortable arrangement of straps around the torso made for slaves. It reminds the wearer of their slave status and psychologically suppresses them, reducing the chance of a slave rebellion.

intro: Slave body straps are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC that decreases the rate of suppression loss when worn by slaves.

title: Slave collar

fields.name: Slave collar
fields.description: An uncomfortable collar made for slaves. It reminds the wearer of their slave status and psychologically suppresses them, reducing the chance of a slave rebellion.

intro: Slave collars are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC. It covers the neck and provides additional slave suppression.

title: Slicecap

fields.name: Slicecap
fields.description: A hard cap that partly covers the wearer's scalp.

intro: Slicecaps are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC. A form of headwear, it covers less and provides very little protection and insulation compared to other options.

title: Stellic crown

fields.name: Stellic crown
fields.description: A grand crown of metal with an elaborate, overbearing design.

intro: The Stellic crown is a clothing item added in the Royalty DLC. It provides a +20% increase to Social Impact, and meets the headwear requirements of nobles of Dominus rank and above, including the Stellarch themself.

title: T-shirt

fields.name: T-shirt
fields.description: A simple T-shirt.

intro: The T-shirt is one of two shirts available in core RimWorld. Compared to its alternative, the Button-down shirt, slightly reduced labour and material requirements at the cost of inferior coverage and cold insulation.

title: Tailcap

fields.name: Tailcap
fields.description: A thick cap made from animal skin with a stylish bushy tail. Great for keeping warm in winter.

intro: Tailcaps are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC. They provide very good cold insulation but don't provide heat insulation nor a Social Impact bonus like many other hats.

title: Top hat

fields.name: Top hat
fields.description: A tall, stiff, shiny hat.

intro: The top hat is a clothing item added in the Royalty DLC. It provides a +20% increase to Social Impact, and meets the headwear requirements of male nobles between Acolyte and Praetor rank.

title: Torture crown

fields.name: Torture crown
fields.description: A crown-like headpiece with stubby inward-facing spikes that poke the head. It is used to induce pain in the wearer.

intro: Torture crowns are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC. They add pain, for those who want to suffer. Despite being called "crowns", they have no relation to nobles or more traditional crowns.

title: Tribal headdress

fields.name: Tribal headdress
fields.description: Elegant traditional garb, often with religious significance. Improves social impact.

intro: The tribal headdress is a tribal clothing item that covers the head. It provides a +15% increase to Social Impact, minimal armor for the head and ears, and modest insulation.

title: Tribalwear

fields.name: Tribalwear
fields.description: A full-body garment crafted using neolithic tools. While it may look primitive, it is effective at insulating the wearer.

intro: Tribalwear is the only neolithic item of clothing in RimWorld. It covers both the torso and legs, meaning it is worn in place of a shirt and pants.

title: Tuque

fields.name: Tuque
fields.description: A soft, thick cap. Great for keeping warm in winter.

intro: Tuques are woolly caps worn in colder climates to protect the upper head and ears from the bitter cold and wind chill from the likes of ice sheets and tundras. Unlike cowboy hats and bowler hats, tuques don't provide a Social Impact bonus.

title: Vacsuit

fields.name: Vacsuit
fields.description: A protective suit that keeps the user safe in the vacuum of space. The suit restricts the wearer's movement, considerably reducing their movement speed.
fields.coverage: Torso, Neck, Left Shoulder, Left Arm, Right Shoulder, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg

intro: The vacsuit is an item of apparel added by the Odyssey DLC. It forms a set with the vacsuit helmet.

title: Vacsuit helmet

fields.name: Vacsuit helmet
fields.description: A helmet that efficiently recycles the user's oxygen, allowing them to breathe in the vacuum of space for hours at a time. The process isn't perfectly efficient, so the user must periodically return to a pressurized environment.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: The vacsuit helmet is an item of apparel added by the Odyssey DLC that provides significant vacuum resistance, for use in the vacuum of space. It forms a set with the vacsuit.

title: Veil

fields.name: Veil
fields.description: A piece of fabric which covers the wearer's face. Hover title|Only appears with the Biotech DLC enabled|It protects surprisingly well against pollution.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: The veil is a clothing item that provides minor protection for the head and a minor increase to pain shock threshold.

title: Visage mask

fields.name: Visage mask
fields.description: A hard facial mask that resembles a stylized face.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: Visage masks are a form of clothing added by the Ideology DLC. They cover the head entirely.

title: War mask

fields.name: War mask
fields.description: An artistically terrifying war mask. Hides the wearer's face and makes them more confident.
fields.coverage: Head, Left Eye, Right Eye, Left Ear, Right Ear, Nose, Jaw

intro: The war mask is a tribal clothing item. It provides minor protection, as well as increasing pain shock threshold, allowing the wearer to take more pain before being downed.
